_comment: Hand-curated layer of docs/capabilities.json (capability-config.md §2 p.3). The emitter (stapel_webhooks/_capabilities.py) derives key/kind/default of each axis from conf.py DEFAULTS and the operations from docs/schema.json + urls_v1.GATE_REGISTRY, and merges this layer over them; an axis selected by _capabilities.AXES but missing here (or vice versa) is a loud emission error. The surface section is derived from surface_roots by AST; a selected symbol without an intent line fails `make contract`.
provides: The reaction layer: declarative 'when event X happens, do Y' subscriptions over the fleet's comm Actions, delivered as HMAC-signed retried webhooks, notifications, realtime frames or allowlisted app-layer callables, with a per-delivery evidence row, a retry ladder, a dead letter and replay.

WATCH_CATALOG.summary: On by default: every event an installed package declares in schemas/emits/ can be subscribed to, so what customers may react to follows what is installed. Off: only WATCH_EVENTS are wired.

DISPATCH_MODE.summary: deferred (default): a matching event writes delivery rows and a drain performs the network calls. inline: deliver right after commit in the emitting process — a dev/monolith convenience that webhooks.W004 warns about.

ALLOW_INSECURE_TARGETS.business_label: Deliver to private or plain-http endpoints
ALLOW_INSECURE_TARGETS.summary: Ships closed: webhook targets must be https and resolve to a public address (SSRF guard). True opens http:// and private/loopback targets for a dev box or an in-cluster receiver; webhooks.W003 reports it while it is on.

extension_points.name: DELIVERY_TYPES
extension_points.summary: Delivery-type registry ({name: spec | None}, merged over the webhook/notification/ws/custom built-ins; register_delivery_type() at runtime). None removes a type — how a host closes custom. A spec replaces, no deep merge.

extension_points.name: TRANSPORT
extension_points.summary: The outbound HTTP transport (post + classify): egress proxy, mTLS or a test double. The default carries the SSRF guard. Never read from the environment.

extension_points.name: SIGNER
extension_points.summary: Signature scheme (sign/verify) — speak another provider's signature dialect. Never read from the environment.

extension_points.name: MATCHER
extension_points.summary: The subscription filter language: callable(payload, predicate) -> bool. Never read from the environment.

extension_points.name: EXTRA_CATALOG_PATHS
extension_points.summary: Package roots whose schemas/emits/ also feed the event catalog — lets a non-app library contribute subscribable events.

extension_points.name: STAPEL_SWAP["WEBHOOKS_SUBSCRIPTION_PRESENTER"] / ["WEBHOOKS_DELIVERY_PRESENTER"]
extension_points.summary: Reshape either response body with a Presenter subclass.

register_delivery_type.intent: Add, replace or remove (None) a delivery type at runtime, over the built-ins and STAPEL_WEBHOOKS['DELIVERY_TYPES'] — the code twin of the settings seam for a host that registers after boot.

reset_delivery_types.intent: Tests only: drop runtime delivery-type overrides so one test's registration does not leak into the next.

get_delivery_types.intent: The effective delivery-type registry (built-ins <- settings <- runtime, None removing); read this instead of the setting so removals and runtime registrations are honoured.

resolve_delivery.intent: The live spec for one delivery type, raising UnknownDeliveryType for a removed or unknown one — the lookup every planner and validator goes through.

delivery_handler.intent: Import and return a delivery type's handler callable; the one place a spec's dotted path becomes code.

validate_target.intent: Refuse a subscription target its delivery type cannot use (required keys, any-of keys, the type's own target_validator) before a row is written.

is_signed.intent: Whether subscriptions of a delivery type carry an HMAC signing secret — decides whether a secret is minted and shown once.

is_external.intent: Whether a delivery leaves the deployment, i.e. whether the SSRF guard and the external-delivery rules apply.

build_catalog.intent: Scan every source (installed packages' schemas/emits/, EXTRA_CATALOG_PATHS, WATCH_EVENTS) into {event: entry}, uncached — for a check or a command that must see the current state.

event_catalog.intent: Every subscribable event of this deployment, keyed by name (cached) — the vocabulary the create endpoint and webhooks.event_catalog answer from.

reset_catalog.intent: Drop the cached catalog after INSTALLED_APPS changes, and between tests.

catalog_event_names.intent: The sorted subscribable event names — what a subscription UI offers.

is_known_event.intent: Whether an event name is declared by some installed package — the check a subscription create runs before accepting a topic.

event_schema.intent: The declared JSON schema of an event, if the catalog carries one — what a filter builder reads to offer fields.

requires.reason: comm Action bus with the transactional outbox (what is reacted to), Signals (ws delivery), notifications publish (notification delivery), the SSRF address guard, AppSettings, JWT auth and the error envelope
renders and sends the notification delivery type; without it that type cannot deliver
carries the ws delivery type's frames to connected clients
